_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels. Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Speak with Deathguard Linnea.
Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.

quests.n: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.t: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

quests.n: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.t: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.

quests.n: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.t: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.
Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.
Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.
Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.
Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.
Obtain a Candle of Beckoning. Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her. Return to Gunther on his island.
Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.
Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

quests.n: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.t: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.
Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.
Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.
Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Bring Johaan's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.
Defeat Calvin Montague in Deathknell.
Bring Venya Marthand 3 Rattlecage Skulls.
Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.
Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
Kill Ulag the Cleaver, then speak with Deathguard Dillinger.
Speak with Coleman Farthing.
Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.
Speak with Anastasia Hartwell.
Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the Undercity.
Speak with Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.
Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
Find Deathguard Kel and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill.
Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.
Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

quests.n: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
quests.t: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep. Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.
Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
Sit near Eleanor's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.
Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
Speak with Carolai Anise in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Basil Frye in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Vance Undergloom in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Graham Van Talen in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Nurse Neela in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Faruza in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Shelene Rhobart on the road to Undercity from Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Rand Rhobart on the road to Undercity from Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Bowen Brisboise on the road to Brill from Deathknell to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.
Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

o.t: Escort Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost

quests.t: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
